current.text: He is on a two-way contract with Detroit and is the third-string center.
Duren is back and starts at center. Isaiah Stewart is gone and Paul Reed is the main backup big. This leaves thin frontcourt depth ahead of Onyenso.
In dynasty rookie rankings he is ranked 38th in his draft class.
He is a name to watch.

durable.text: He is a big man with a very high block rate. He averaged 2 blocks a game in Summer League.
He started taking threes in his last season before the draft.
His translated fantasy stats rank among the top three in his draft class.
He could build fantasy value from blocks, rebounds and FG%, like Walker Kessler. One expert says his fantasy potential is through the roof.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Third-string center with an elite block rate. Watch if Duren or Reed miss time.
